extraction_text: At the Sarasvati River, satisfying ancestors and gods leads to enjoyment in the world of Sarasvati.

At Varanasi, worshipping Shiva with the bull banner and bathing in Kapila Lake grants the merit of a Rajasuya sacrifice.

extraction_text: At Tenuka, staying one night and offering sesame and cows purifies the soul of sins and leads to the world of the moon.
